notes.title: I Live Under Your House IS BACK
notes.notes:
[img][/img]  
[h1][b] I Live Under Your House Remake is Coming Soon![/b][/h1]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697030/I_Live_Under_Your_House_Renovation/?beta=0  

This isn't just a graphics update - this is a significantly improved version of the game in all aspects featuring:
- Completely reworked dialogues
- An additional act  
- Foreign language support  
- Preservation of the cult classic atmosphere  

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45126928/0b1ac1029dcaff57c30b5043c99d2a07b87938d0.gif[/img]  

Over these three years, I've collected hundreds of community feedback pieces and gained experience that allowed me to reveal the full potential of the ILUYH universe in new ways.

This version includes:  
• Brand new high-quality graphics  
• Enhanced dialogues and monologues  
• Strengthened psychological elements  

Thank you to everyone who has supported me all these years and shown interest in the world of I Live Under Your House.

Warning: The remake contains even more violent scenes and descriptions - for prepared audiences only.

notes.title: Attention observer!
notes.notes:
You carefully reviewed the submitted materials, which is what was required of you. 
We came to the conclusion that you can still be useful to us.
This story is far from over.
A new...ahem...specimen has been discovered in the wild forests of Mesopotamia.
Your task is to go there with a group of scientists and monitor the group. 
Don’t worry, you won’t be in any danger, we will carefully monitor the whole process.
All you need to do is keep diaries about changes in behavior within the group. 
You showed such remarkable powers of observation during your first assignment, we are confident you will cope with this task. 
Expect an update soon.
Thank you for all the work you've done and the work you have yet to do.
